note: One anchor, in List's own render, immediately after the line that clamps state.offset to what was actually drawn. Read there and not earlier: rendering mutates the state, so a pre-render read reports what the application asked for rather than what the user sees. This crate is patched at all because List::items is pub(crate) — the item text and the item count are unreachable from outside and reachable from within, which is what makes setSize and item names obtainable.

requires.reason: The dependency's path is machine-specific, so the applier writes it in.
